title: CYBRIK investigation-packet common definitions v1
description: Shared enums for the W0-I01 Investigation/Claim/Evidence/Bundle packet (additive to, and disjoint from, the accepted v0.1 packet and the ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION W2-D/W2-F/W2-G packets). Realizes ADR-0006 E6's deferred instruction that investigation-scoped correlation semantics be 'defined per event class and enforced by accepted schemas later' (this packet is that later definition). Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA) by explicit Founder Option A and G-W0I01-1..5=yes on 2026-07-26.

investigationStatus.description: Investigation lifecycle state. 'abstained' is a first-class terminal state (roadmap Week 2: an investigation MUST be able to say 'insufficient data' instead of forcing a verdict), distinct from 'completed'.

claimStatus.description: 'asserted' claims MUST be grounded in evidence (see cybrik.claim.v1 allOf); 'abstained' claims record that the evidence was insufficient/conflicting to assert anything, which is itself a required, honest output (roadmap Week 2 'Abstention/missing-evidence output'), not an error.

evidenceKind.description: What kind of product-owned object cybrik.evidence.v1.source_ref points at. Evidence never inlines the referenced object's content beyond a short excerpt (strategy 05 §4.5: dereferenced through the owner's authorized API, never a public URL).

confidenceLevel.description: Deliberately coarse (not a numeric score) so a claim cannot manufacture false precision. Required on every 'asserted' claim; MUST be absent on an 'abstained' claim (you do not hold a confidence level in something you are declining to assert).

abstentionReason.description: Why an investigation or claim abstained instead of asserting. Required whenever status='abstained' (investigation or claim).
